title: billing-window-compact: event-sourced token delta compactor and late-arrival fallback
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: The current billing ingestion pipeline emits per-request token events into a high-volume topic and downstream billing jobs either rehydrate large time ranges or emit many small records, leading to high cost, slow downstream joins, and fragile late-arrival handling. Goal: build an online compactor that consumes token-delta events, produces compacted hourly billing windows per customer+route+model, and emits deterministic tombstoned corrections for late events. The compactor must be streaming-first (Kafka consumer group), idempotent, support at-least-once source semantics, tolerate out-of-order events (event time skew up to 12 hours), and provide a fallback full-aggregation mode for recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Compactor consumes token-delta topic and emits compacted records to billing-compact topic with <=10s processing lag under 95th percentile load
Compacted messages reduce downstream join cardinality by >=70% in staging run
Late-arriving events for windows within 24h trigger a correction message with previous and corrected aggregates
Metrics exposed: input rate, output rate, processing lag, re-compactions/sec, checkpoint lag
Automated e2e test that injects out-of-order events and validates final billed totals match a golden SQL run
design_notes: Architecture: event-sourced compactor service running in k8s, consumer group per-shard keyed by customer_id % N
Windowing: fixed-hour tumbling windows by event_time (UTC). Each compacted key: customer_id|route_id|model_id|window_start
State: local RocksDB-backed state per partition + Kafka-head checkpoints in ZooKeeper/consumer offsets store. Durable checkpoints written to DynamoDB for cross-restart reconciliation.

Late-arrival handling: maintain mutable window state for 24h; on late event update emit a correction record with old_value, new_value, and correction_reason. For >24h late events, mark for async full-recompact job.
Idempotency: include compaction_version and input_offsets vector hash in output message; downstream billing joins use compaction_version to dedupe

Failure/fallback: if compactor detects inconsistent offsets or state corruption, it will flip a feature flag and emit watermark to trigger a scheduled full-aggregation job that recomputes recent windows from raw topic
Backpressure: use consumer pause + bounded executor; expose backpressure metrics to autoscaler (HPA)
implementation_plan: Phase 1: prototype compactor in staging reading from token-delta topic, emit compacted hourly windows to billing-compact-staging (2 weeks)
Phase 2: add late-arrival correction logic, persistent checkpoints to DynamoDB, and idempotency metadata (1 week)
Phase 3: end-to-end integration tests, run side-by-side with existing aggregator for 2 days, verify output parity and cost savings (1 week)
Phase 4: gradual rollout to production by customer shards with canary for top 10 customers (1 week)
Phase 5: implement async recompact job for >24h late events and incident playbook (ongoing)
observability_and_slos: SLO: Processing lag < 30s p95, Compaction correctness 100% for windows <=24h
Dashboards: input rate, output rate, p50/p95 processing lag, re-compactions/sec, failed corrections, checkpoint lag
Alerts: >5% correction rate sustained for 15m, consumer lag >1M messages, checkpoint write errors >= 5/min
Cost metric: token events processed per dollar compared to baseline aggregator
testing_plan: Unit tests for windowing logic, idempotency metadata generation
Integration test harness that replays Kafka recordings with configurable time skew
Chaos test: restart compactor pod mid-window and assert no double-emits or data loss
Staging A/B: run compactor and legacy aggregator in parallel and diff outputs for 48h
rollout_plan: Canary: enable compactor for internal test accounts and top 3 low-traffic customers
Shard-based rollout: enable per-customer shard with health-check gating (consumer lag, correction rate)
Fallback: a feature flag flip will stop compactor writes and enqueue full-recompact job for affected shards
Post-rollout: monitor cost reduction dashboard and sign-off by PM and FinOps
